ingredients.title: Chicken
items: 1 bottle teriyaki sauce, enough to cover the chicken

instructions.title: Chicken
items: Add chicken thighs to the instant pot
Add teriyaki sauce to cover the chicken
Use about a tablespoon of water and swish around the bottle to get all the remaining sauce out
Pressure cook on high for 9-12 minutes
Slow release recommended for more tender chicken, at least 5 minutes

instructions.title: Rice
items: After the chicken has begun cooking in the instant pot, make rice in a rice cooker
